answer: In an economy of delivery agents serving a meadow, a ridge, and the valley’s nadir, each agent must lock a $100 bond for 30 days to obtain one job slot. Dispatch capacity is proportional to locked funds, not account count, so splitting one budget across fake identities creates no extra capacity. An attacker seeking 1,000 simultaneous slots must immobilize $100,000 for a month, paying financing costs even if none of its accounts is detected.
